instrument_name: Arkansas DOLL Minimum Wage and Overtime page
authority: Arkansas Department of Labor and Licensing (Labor Standards)
article_or_section: Minimum wage; Tipped employees; Deductions from Minimum Wage; Overtime; Compensatory time
figure_or_rule_carried: State minimum wage 11.00/h effective 2021-01-01 (2018 Initiated Act, Issue 5); Act covers employers with 4 or more employees; employer covered by both FLSA and state law pays the higher; overtime 1.5x regular rate over 40 h/workweek (no daily overtime); tipped cash wage at least 2.63/h, tips must reach the minimum wage; non-standard deductions (spoilage, shortages, fines) may not take pay below minimum wage; court-ordered deductions, third-party wage assignments and board/lodging/apparel may; compensatory time only for public agencies. Page names no 2027 increase and no local minimum wage.

instrument_name: Arkansas Act 853 of 2019 (HB1751) amending the Minimum Wage Act and Ark. Code 11-4-403, 11-4-405
figure_or_rule_carried: 11-4-405 rewritten: an employer that discharges an employee pays all wages due by the next regular payday; failure to pay within 7 days of that payday = employer owes double the wages due. No statutory deadline for resignations located. 11-4-403(f): payment by automatic deposit or preloaded debit card is lawful; paycard must allow at least one free withdrawal per wage load (no consent clause in the text). 11-4-213: board/lodging/apparel credit = fair and reasonable cost per 29 USC 203(m)/29 CFR 531 (was 30 cents/h). 11-4-218(g): 2-year limitation. Supersedes the 2008 DOL compilation text of 11-4-213 and 11-4-405 (US-AR-P5-1-004 stays the source for unamended sections). Read from the Wayback copy; arkleg.state.ar.us fails TLS (curl exit 35) from this machine. Strike-through/underline not distinguishable in text extraction: final wording inferred from the closing sentences of Sec. 7.

instrument_name: Arkansas Act 1019 of 2021 (SB 484): allocation of nonresident income by physical location
figure_or_rule_carried: STATUS: IN FORCE (approved 2021-04-29, emergency clause). LEVEL: assessment (26-51-202(c), 26-51-504) and withholding (26-51-902(5) employer definition). A nonresident pays AR tax only on income reasonably allocable to work performed in AR; a nonresident performs work in AR when physically located in AR while working (ends any convenience-of-employer sourcing; Sec. 2-3 effective for tax years from 2021-01-01). Resident credit for tax owed to another state, capped at the AR tax on that income; income for work physically performed in AR is not 'outside income' for the credit. Employer = person with control of payment of wages for services performed in AR, including out-of-state persons (Sec. 4, first day of the month after approval). Answers MULTI-OQ-5 from the primary text. Read from the Wayback copy (arkleg TLS failure).

instrument_name: Arkansas DFA OCSE - Paying Child Support FAQ
authority: Arkansas DFA Office of Child Support Enforcement
article_or_section: Q: amount billed for income withholding does not match the court order; Q: paying through the Clerk of Court
figure_or_rule_carried: Most AR orders add 10% of current support toward arrears (some orders now 20% after a recent law change, act not named); example 56.00/week + 5.60 = 61.60; the court may set a specific arrears amount; withholding capped by CCPA at 50% (second family) / 60% (no second family) of disposable earnings (+5% when 12+ weeks in arrears per CCPA, not restated here); when support is withheld from wages the employer must remit to the Arkansas Child Support Clearinghouse (state law). Employer administrative fee not stated on the page.

instrument_name: Arkansas Form AR4EC Employee's Withholding Exemption Certificate (R 12/04/2025)
article_or_section: Lines 1a-1c (1 or 2 exemptions); line 2 dependents; line 3 total; line 4 additional amount; line 5 low-income rates; instructions
figure_or_rule_carried: State certificate (federal W-4 not used for AR). Exemptions: self 1; self+spouse 2; head of household 2; plus 1 per dependent; additional flat amount per paycheck; line 5 Yes/No 'I qualify for the low-income tax rates' with 2026 income bands: single 14,644-17,500; MFJ 0-1 dependent 24,696-29,000; MFJ 2+ 29,723-36,100; HoH/QW 0-1 20,821-25,300; HoH/QW 2+ 24,819-29,000. No certificate filed -> withhold with zero exemptions. Employee must file a new certificate within 10 days when exemptions decrease (divorce/separation, dependent support below half); other decreases (death) by 1 December. Filing status boxes Single / MFJ / HoH.

instrument_name: Arkansas Form AR4ECSP Employee's Special Withholding Exemption Certificate (R 12/04/2025)
figure_or_rule_carried: Employee claims full exemption from AR withholding when gross income from all sources will not exceed: single 14,643; MFJ 0-1 dependent 24,695; MFJ 2+ 29,722; HoH/QW 0-1 20,820; HoH/QW 2+ 24,818 (each 1 below the lower bound of the AR4EC low-income band). Employer keeps the certificate.

instrument_name: Arkansas Withholding Tax Low Income Tax Tables (effective 01/01/2026)
article_or_section: 23 pages; weekly/bi-weekly/... by filing status and 0-6 dependents
figure_or_rule_carried: Separate table-only method for employees who check AR4EC line 5 (low-income rates); no formula published for it. Single weekly: wages 0.00-281.60 -> 0 withholding (281.60 x 52 = 14,643.20, consistent with the AR4ECSP single ceiling 14,643); bi-weekly 0.00-563.19 -> 0. The engine must carry these tables (or a derived formula proven against them) in addition to the regular formula (US-ARS5-001).

authority: Arkansas Department of Labor and Licensing (Labor Standards)
figure_or_rule_carried: DOLL investigates wage claims of 2,000 or less from workers earning 50,000 or less a year (employees or contractors who physically performed the work); typical issues: last paycheck, commissions, vacation pay, bonuses, unauthorized deductions. A claim for vacation, sick, holiday, bonus or severance pay requires a copy of the company policy promising that pay -> payout of accrued vacation at termination is a matter of employer policy, not statute.
